/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-a-c-corpora.title: How does a C corporation dividend and its second tax layer work?

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-retaining-e.title: How does retaining earnings in a C corporation work?

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-owner-payro.title: How does owner payroll as a C corporation expense work?

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-a-c-corpora.title: How does a C corporation capital contribution work?

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-equipment-p.title: How does equipment purchases inside a C corporation work?

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-a-corporate.title: How does a corporate loan to a shareholder work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-a-corporate.description: A genuine corporate loan creates shareholder debt. Repayment intent, terms, interest and actual conduct must support the loan.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-a-c-corpora.title: How does a C corporation business reserve work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-a-c-corpora.description: Corporate cash should be considered in light of actual business needs and applicable accumulation rules.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-a-c-corpora.title: How does a C corporation loss at the company level work?

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-the-transit.title: How does the transition from C corporation to S taxation work?

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-s-corporati.title: How does S corporation payroll versus distributions work?

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-an-s-corpor.title: How does an S corporation stock basis increase work?

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-s-corporati.title: How does S corporation loss limitation review work?

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-s-corporati.title: How does S corporation health insurance reimbursement work?

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-an-s-corpor.title: How does an S corporation tax distribution work?

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-an-s-corpor.title: How does an S corporation shareholder loan repayment work?

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-partnership.title: How does partnership income from Form 1065 to the partner work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-partnership.description: A partnership generally allocates items on Schedule K-1. Partners report their shares under applicable rules; cash distributions need not equal allocations.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-partnership.title: How does partnership profit allocation versus cash distribution work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-partnership.description: Partnership profit allocations determine taxable shares. Cash distributions affect basis and can create gain when they exceed outside basis.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-a-guarantee.title: How does a guaranteed payment to a partner work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-a-guarantee.description: A qualifying guaranteed payment is determined without regard to partnership income. Its reporting and deduction or capitalization depend on the facts.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-a-partner-c.title: How does a partner capital contribution work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-a-partner-c.description: Cash or property contributed as capital funds the partnership and generally affects the contributing partner's outside basis.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-partnership.title: How does partnership debt in outside basis work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-partnership.description: A partner's share of qualifying liabilities can affect outside basis. Liability type and allocation matter; basis is not the same as being at risk.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-partnership.title: How does partnership losses on the partner return work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-partnership.description: The partnership allocates the loss, but the partner must apply outside-basis, at-risk, passive and other applicable limitations.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-a-partnersh.title: How does a partnership tax distribution work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-a-partnersh.description: The partnership can distribute cash under its governing agreement to fund partners' tax obligations. Taxable allocations and distribution treatment remain separate.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-participati.title: How does participation in a rental partnership work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-participati.description: The partnership allocates economic items under applicable rules, while material participation is generally evaluated for each owner.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-reimbursing.title: How does reimbursing a partner business expense work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-reimbursing.description: A reimbursement accounts for actual partnership business costs paid by a partner, while a guaranteed payment compensates under its own rules.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-buying-a-pa.title: How does buying a partnership interest rather than its property work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-buying-a-pa.description: An interest purchase creates outside basis for the buyer, while the partnership owns its assets with inside basis.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-the-split-f.title: How does the split from gross wages to net pay work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-the-split-f.description: Gross wages are reduced by applicable employee taxes and other authorized deductions to arrive at net pay. The employer remits withheld amounts under deposit rules.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-the-employe.title: How does the employer share of payroll taxes work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-the-employe.description: The employer can owe payroll taxes in addition to the employee amounts withheld from wages. Rates, wage bases and special rules depend on the tax and year.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-remitting-p.title: How does remitting payroll withholding to the IRS work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-remitting-p.description: Amounts withheld must be deposited and reported according to the employer's applicable schedule.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-payroll-for.title: How does payroll for a sole S corporation shareholder work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-payroll-for.description: A single working shareholder still needs supported wage treatment and applicable employment-tax reporting. Reasonable compensation is based on actual services.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-a-bonus-pay.title: How does a bonus payment through payroll work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-a-bonus-pay.description: A cash bonus generally has withholding and payroll tax treatment. Supplemental-wage withholding need not equal the employee's final income-tax rate.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-an-employee.title: How does an employee 401(k) payroll deferral work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-an-employee.description: An eligible elected deferral is withheld from compensation and sent to the plan under applicable requirements.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-employee-ve.title: How does employee versus contractor payment classification work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-employee-ve.description: The worker's actual relationship determines whether employee payroll or independent-contractor treatment applies.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-employee-re.title: How does employee reimbursement versus additional wages work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-employee-re.description: A properly substantiated reimbursement under an accountable arrangement can be treated differently from wages. Nonaccountable payments generally need wage treatment.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-paying-a-sp.title: How does paying a spouse through business payroll work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-paying-a-sp.description: A spouse must perform genuine services, and compensation and payroll treatment depend on the entity and applicable family-employment rules. Record duties and actual pay.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-reconciling.title: How does reconciling Form 941 and W-2 totals work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-reconciling.description: Quarterly payroll reporting and annual employee reporting should connect to the payroll records, with differences investigated and corrected appropriately.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-a-real-mana.title: How does a real management fee between two entities work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-a-real-mana.description: Management fees require actual services and a supportable arrangement. Review payer deduction or capitalization, related-party rules and recipient income.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-related-par.title: How does related-party pricing in a two-entity arrangement work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-related-par.description: Controlled transactions must be supportable under applicable pricing and allocation rules.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-separating-.title: How does separating property ownership from operations work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-separating-.description: Separate ownership can distinguish operating activity from property ownership, but tax classification and related-party use still matter.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-shared-payr.title: How does shared payroll cost allocation between entities work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-shared-payr.description: Actual employees, services and cost allocation must be documented. Employment, benefit-plan, agency and related-employer rules need review before centralizing payroll.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-a-royalty-b.title: How does a royalty between commonly owned companies work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-a-royalty-b.description: A royalty needs genuine intellectual-property rights, actual use, supportable pricing and consistent reporting. Legal ownership and development history matter.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-a-loan-betw.title: How does a loan between commonly owned entities work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-a-loan-betw.description: A bona fide loan creates a payable for one entity and a receivable for the other. Principal is generally a balance-sheet movement rather than a service expense.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-a-parent-ca.title: How does a parent capital contribution to a subsidiary work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-a-parent-ca.description: Equity funding increases the investment and capital records; it is not a deductible fee for services merely because money leaves the parent account.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-paying-a-ve.title: How does paying a vendor from the wrong entity account work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-paying-a-ve.description: Identify which entity incurred the obligation and whether the other entity paid as an agent, lender or investor.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-a-transfer-.title: How does a transfer between two commonly owned LLCs work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-a-transfer-.description: Tax treatment of transfers between commonly owned LLCs depends on federal classification. Disregarded entities can differ from separate taxpayers.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-owner-cash-.title: How does owner cash extraction in a two-entity plan work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-owner-cash-.description: Follow the cash through both entities and then the owner payment. A payer deduction may create recipient income, and a corporate dividend can add shareholder tax.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-rental-inco.title: How does rental income reporting from tenant to owner work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-rental-inco.description: Reconcile gross rent and other rental receipts with property expenses and depreciation, then apply applicable limitations on the owner return.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-a-rental-mo.title: How does a rental mortgage principal and interest split work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-a-rental-mo.description: Principal reduces debt, while qualifying interest can be a rental expense under applicable rules.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-noncash-dep.title: How does noncash depreciation against rental income work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-noncash-dep.description: Depreciation allocates qualifying property basis over time or under eligible acceleration rules. It can create a tax expense without a current cash payment.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-depreciatio.title: How does depreciation after home-to-rental conversion work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-depreciatio.description: Establish the rental service date and apply the conversion basis rules, which can use the lower of adjusted basis or fair market value for depreciation.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-a-rental-im.title: How does a rental improvement on the asset schedule work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-a-rental-im.description: A capital improvement is generally added to an asset schedule rather than deducted as an ordinary repair. Identify its cost, classification and service date.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-rental-secu.title: How does rental security deposit accounting work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-rental-secu.description: A refundable deposit is generally tracked as a liability until returned or applied under the lease. Advance rent is different.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-vacation-re.title: How does vacation rental personal-use allocation work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-vacation-re.description: Personal and rental use can require expense allocation and trigger special vacation-home limitations.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-a-short-ter.title: How does a short-term rental loss on the household return work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-a-short-ter.description: Classify the activity, evaluate participation and apply basis, at-risk, passive and other relevant limits.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-property-ma.title: How does property manager fees and net remittances work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-property-ma.description: The manager may collect rent, deduct fees and remit net cash, but the owner must reconcile gross income and qualifying expenses.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-rental-sale.title: How does rental sale gain versus net closing cash work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-rental-sale.description: Tax gain generally uses amount realized and adjusted basis, while closing cash also reflects mortgage payoff and settlement items.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-an-employer.title: How does an employer retirement plan contribution work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-an-employer.description: The employer funds the retirement account under the plan rules, with deduction timing, limits and employee requirements reviewed separately.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-a-pretax-em.title: How does a pretax employee salary deferral work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-a-pretax-em.description: Eligible pretax salary deferrals generally reduce current federal income-tax wages, while employment-tax treatment must be applied separately.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-a-roth-401-.title: How does a Roth 401(k) payroll deferral work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-a-roth-401-.description: A designated Roth deferral generally uses compensation included in current taxable income. Qualified withdrawal treatment differs from pretax money.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-a-cash-bala.title: How does a cash balance plan funding obligation work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-a-cash-bala.description: A cash balance plan is a defined benefit plan with actuarial calculations and ongoing funding requirements.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-retirement-.title: How does retirement coverage after hiring employees work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-retirement-.description: Eligible common-law employees can change an owner-only plan's participation and testing requirements.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-s-corporati.title: How does S corporation salary for retirement contributions work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-s-corporati.description: Eligible compensation, generally W-2 wages, supports S corporation retirement plan calculations. Distributions do not create compensation for this purpose.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-a-sep-emplo.title: How does a SEP employer contribution work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-a-sep-emplo.description: A SEP generally involves employer contributions under its eligibility and allocation rules; it is not the same mechanism as employee 401(k) salary deferrals.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-retirement-.title: How does retirement coverage across two companies work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-retirement-.description: Controlled-group and affiliated-service-group rules can require businesses to be considered together.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-retirement-.title: How does retirement funding alongside business expansion work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-retirement-.description: Funding moves cash out of business liquidity and into the plan, even when a deduction lowers current tax.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-a-retiremen.title: How does a retirement contribution correction with payroll work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-a-retiremen.description: The correction depends on whether the problem is an excess deferral, annual addition, employer deduction or operational error.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-an-accounta.title: How does an accountable plan reimbursement work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-an-accounta.description: The employee substantiates a qualifying business cost and returns excess advances; the company records the reimbursement under the applicable rules.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-an-owner-pa.title: How does an owner-paid expense for the correct entity work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-an-owner-pa.description: Identify which taxpayer incurred the business obligation, then document reimbursement, contribution or another appropriate arrangement.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-mixed-use-v.title: How does mixed-use vehicle expense allocation work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-mixed-use-v.description: Separate business, commuting and personal use, then apply an eligible expense method consistently. A company payment does not make all miles business-related.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-the-busines.title: How does the business meal deduction review work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-the-busines.description: The business purpose and substantiation must support the underlying expense, and applicable deduction limits still apply.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-travel-adva.title: How does travel advances and expense reconciliation work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-travel-adva.description: Substantiated qualifying costs under an accountable arrangement can receive different treatment from a nonaccountable allowance.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-depreciatio.title: How does depreciation versus immediate expensing work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-depreciatio.description: Depreciation recovers qualifying asset cost under tax rules over time or eligible acceleration provisions. Expensing requires its own eligibility and election analysis.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-business-in.title: How does business interest versus principal repayment work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-business-in.description: Qualifying business interest can have expense treatment, subject to limits and tracing. Principal repayment reduces debt and generally is not an expense.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-an-expense-.title: How does an expense correction across business and personal returns work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-an-expense-.description: An expense adjustment can change entity income, owner allocations, basis and the household calculation.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-home-office.title: How does home office eligibility before reimbursement work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-home-office.description: A home office needs eligible use and supporting records; reimbursement and individual deduction treatment depend on the owner's employment and entity facts.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-preventing-.title: How does preventing duplicate owner reimbursements work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-preventing-.description: Document each business expense, purpose and prior payment or reimbursement. One cost should not be reimbursed or deducted twice because both owners used it.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-an-owner-lo.title: How does an owner loan on the business balance sheet work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-an-owner-lo.description: A genuine advance creates a business payable and an owner receivable. Principal funding is not customer income or a wage expense.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-owner-equit.title: How does owner equity funding versus a business loan work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-owner-equit.description: Capital is an ownership investment, while a genuine loan creates a repayment obligation. The economic facts and documentation determine treatment.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-repayment-o.title: How does repayment of a loan with reduced debt basis work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-repayment-o.description: An S corporation loss deduction can reduce basis in qualifying shareholder debt. Loan repayment can then be taxable; reconcile any basis restoration.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-a-sharehold.title: How does a shareholder guarantee versus a direct loan work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-a-sharehold.description: A guarantee commits the owner to possible repayment but generally does not itself create S corporation debt basis. A bona fide direct advance has different facts.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-shareholder.title: How does shareholder loan interest reporting work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-shareholder.description: Interest is separate from principal and can create income to the lender, with payer deduction treatment subject to applicable rules.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-stock-basis.title: How does stock basis versus company bank cash work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-stock-basis.description: Stock basis reflects owner investment and prescribed tax adjustments. Company cash from borrowing, earnings or other events does not establish that basis.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-a-stock-con.title: How does a stock contribution before a distribution work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-a-stock-con.description: A genuine capital contribution generally increases stock basis, while a later distribution must be evaluated under the applicable ordering and distribution rules.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-intercompan.title: How does intercompany loan principal repayment work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-intercompan.description: Principal repayment settles a liability; it is not generally a deductible operating expense.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-classificat.title: How does classification of company-paid personal bills work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-classificat.description: Identify whether the payment is compensation, a distribution, a bona fide loan or another supported item.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-a-loan-sche.title: How does a loan schedule in the business return work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-a-loan-sche.description: Opening principal, advances, repayments, interest and ending balances should reconcile with the books and supporting agreements. Tax basis can differ from principal.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-estimated-t.title: How does estimated tax versus payroll withholding work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-estimated-t.description: Estimated payments are made directly toward the owner's tax liability, while payroll withholding is taken from compensation and remitted through the employer.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-a-tax-reser.title: How does a tax reserve followed by an owner payment work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-a-tax-reser.description: A business tax reserve is not a deduction. Classify the transfer to the owner correctly; the estimated payment reduces tax due, not operating profit.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-a-tax-safe-.title: How does a tax safe harbor versus final liability work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-a-tax-safe-.description: A safe harbor can protect against an underpayment penalty when its requirements are met. The final tax return still calculates actual liability from current facts.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-annualized-.title: How does annualized income for estimated installments work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-annualized-.description: The annualized income installment method considers uneven income and deductions. It requires timely records and the applicable calculation, not simply delayed payments.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-a-rental-sa.title: How does a rental sale in a new payment projection work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-a-rental-sa.description: A sale can add gain and depreciation-related amounts to the household return. Mortgage payoff affects cash, not the same tax calculation.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-tax-payment.title: How does tax payments during a filing extension work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-tax-payment.description: An extension generally changes the filing timeline without automatically extending the tax payment deadline.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-a-prior-yea.title: How does a prior-year overpayment applied forward work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-a-prior-yea.description: A properly elected carryforward applies an overpayment toward the next year's tax, with credit timing determined under applicable rules.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-quarterly-b.title: How does quarterly books in an owner tax projection work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-quarterly-b.description: A reliable projection starts with reconciled business results and adds tax adjustments and household items.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-spouse-with.title: How does spouse withholding for joint business income work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-spouse-with.description: On a joint return, household withholding can help cover combined tax. Review withholding, annual rules and other income before reducing estimated payments.

/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-paying-an-i.title: How does paying an individual final tax balance work?
/blog/how-tax-moves-how-does-paying-an-i.description: A personal federal income-tax payment generally is not a business deduction. It settles the owner's liability after the return computation.
